The period between polling and vote counting is marked by debate on various issues including **Chief Minister M.K.Stalin's** holiday plans and comparisons of the state's IT sector performance with other southern states. The presence of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), led by actor C. Joseph Vijay, also raises questions about potential coalition governments.

recent_articles.title: TVK chief Vijay’s assets: Another case in Madras High Court questions loan extended to estranged wife Sangeetha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A new writ petition has been filed in the Madras High Court seeking an inquiry into the assets declared by **C. Joseph Vijay**, president of the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, while filing his nomination papers for the Perambur Assembly constituency election.  The petitioner, M.P. Venkatesh, argues that the disclosures made by Mr. Vijay are misleading and raise concerns about potential fraud in the electoral process. The petition also cites discrepancies in Mr. Vijay's financial disclosures, including loans to family members and a large transfer to a trust. This case joins two other similar cases filed against former AIADMK Ministers D. Jayakumar and C.Ve. Shanmugam, both contesting from different constituencies.

recent_articles.title: T.N. Assembly elections: Over 50 lakh more voters exercise their franchise this time compared to 2024 Lok Sabha polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Over 50 lakh more electors participated in the 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly election compared to the 2024 Lok Sabha election. This trend reflects a long-standing tradition of higher voter turnout during Assembly elections, likely due to voters' direct impact from government actions and intense political mobilization. The presence of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam, along with cash distribution, has also contributed to increased participation.  The Election Commission of India (EC) reported seizures of significant amounts of cash, liquor, drugs, precious metals, and freebies during the election.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu election 2026: Stray incidents of violence break out across State on polling day - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sinora Ashok**, candidate for the TVK party, and **P.K. Sekarbabu**, a Minister and DMK candidate, engaged in a physical altercation after **Sekarbabu** questioned **Ashok's** presence near a booth on Angappa Naicken Street in the Harbour constituency.  The dispute escalated into a protest by **TVK** workers, who claimed they were threatened by **Sekarbabu**. The police intervened to restore order and disperse the protesters.

recent_articles.title: Congress leaders introspect on not aligning with TVK - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**'s decision to not share the stage with **Chief Minister M.K. Stalin** and his perceived favoritism of actor **C. Joseph Vijay**'s **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)** has sparked discussion within the **Congress**.  Reports suggest that **Vijay**'s party is gaining traction in urban areas, prompting speculation about a potential alliance with the **Congress**, which was previously considered before joining the **DMK-led Secular Progressive Alliance**.

recent_articles.title: Congress leaders introspect on not aligning with TVK - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders are expressing regret over their decision to not form an alliance with actor **C. Joseph Vijay**’s **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, believing they missed a chance to rejuvenate the party in Tamil Nadu.  Some members suggest leaving the DMK-led Secular Progressive Alliance immediately and forming an alliance with the TVK if needed to prevent the BJP from coming to power. The TNCC president has demanded an explanation from the Income Tax department after footage showed officials raiding his office, contradicting their claims of no raids.

recent_articles.title: The Karur stampede is yet to fade from the memory of the voters at Velusamypuram - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Velusamypuram**, the site of a deadly political rally tragedy in September 2025, saw brisk polling on Thursday.  Voters were grappling with the lingering impact of the stampede that claimed 41 lives, including nine children, while awaiting answers about the cause and those responsible. **C. Joseph Vijay**, president of the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, was accused in the case but voters largely refrained from discussing it during the election process.  The polling station at Velusamypuram recorded 81.31% turnout with almost four hours remaining before closing.

recent_articles.title: State may witness close contests in many constituencies - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tamil Nadu's** high voter turnout has raised questions about the closeness of this year's election results.  The 2016 contest, with a margin of victory of just one percentage point between the ruling AIADMK and the DMK-led coalition, serves as a precedent for potential close races in 2023. The **People's Welfare Front**, **Pattali Makkal Katchi**, and **Bharatiya Janata Party** contested independently in 2016, contributing to a wider margin of victory for the AIADMK.  This year, the presence of **C. Joseph Vijay**, founder of the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam**, is expected to influence the outcome.
